title: Scout (event discovery)
summary: Technical spec for Scout, the weekly read-only agent that discovers, filters, and ranks upcoming events and emits them to Steward and Usher.
notes: Competing DOC signal (prose-heavy design rationale and ASCII diagrams), but dominant SPEC signals win: concrete Event record JSON schema, Steward write contract JSON, KV config table, schedule/trigger table, and failure-mode contracts the system must honor. Not ADR (no Decision/Consequences) and not PRD (no user stories/acceptance criteria).
